platform: native Windows; operator session, not elevated and not SYSTEM
scope: Independent read-only manifest, destination SHA256, inventory and sampled ACL review; no database rows, job payloads, credential values or private file inventory exported.

sqlite_snapshots.integrity_check_scope: Successful checks recorded by the online-backup implementation; this review rehashed destination bytes without opening snapshot tables.
sqlite_snapshots.consistency: Each online SQLite backup is individually consistent; sources were not quiesced together.

legacy_files.scope: Private watchdog evidence, repair-loop state, wiki/manifests and shared source captures; per-file copies checked against source hashes before and after copying. No cross-file point-in-time guarantee.
legacy_files.content_classification: Raw historical files may contain sensitive material; no assertion that arbitrary historical payloads are secret-free.

private_storage_acl_review.storage_class: Operator-private LocalAppData staging; not protected SYSTEM migration authority
private_storage_acl_review.scope: Both roots and manifests, seven SQLite snapshots, nine collection directories and one content file. Full descendant ACL attestation was not performed.
private_storage_acl_review.required_before_migration: Reverify hashes and create reviewed protected custody/ACLs before using snapshots as SYSTEM deployment authority; retain these originals.

source_and_test_evidence.scope: Existing consolidated Windows test evidence, not a new test run and not SYSTEM/hardware/native-inference acceptance.

previous_code_review_findings_resolved: canonical execution path and lexical reparse rejection
direct Intel core/package temperatures only with missing-final-reading failure
huge numeric values rejected before float conversion
explicit local staging destination and reparse-parent rejection
cpu_probe_review.scope: Read-only source/bundle review. Compiled capabilities evidence does not establish PawnIO driver availability or real CPU temperature.

privileged_prerequisites.scope: User-session read-only inspection only; canceled UAC is not successful elevation.

remaining_holds: Legacy repair-budget authority and legacy-job continuation/routing mapping remain unresolved; snapshots do not authorize fresh or zero-spend ledgers.
Coordinate identified writers for a future consistent cutover; preserve independent Hyper-V Warden ownership and legacy ingress until their disposition is reviewed.
Protected snapshot custody, native SYSTEM/worker ACLs and actual deployment boundaries remain unverified.
CPU driver/protected installation and actual SYSTEM thermal measurements remain unverified; required temperature protection stays enabled.
Existing R startup task ownership remains unverified in the non-elevated scope.
